digest.component_or_area: PydanticAIRunner.run() method and agent call orchestration
propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run() spans 342 lines (49% of runner.py) and must be decomposed per ADR 0056 decision 3 by extracting build_agent_kwargs, log_call_success, and record_call_spend into a new leaf module agent_call.py

Three separated kwargs dict construction fragments (tool_step_limit rewrite, base dict initialization, capabilities key, model_settings key) must be consolidated into a single build_agent_kwargs() function with explicit parameters

Post-call telemetry logging (success-path logger.info and usage_log.record spend) must be extracted as log_call_success() and record_call_spend() functions while preserving their current execution order and error handling semantics

The _anthropic_web_search_capabilities call site must remain in runner.py to prevent monkeypatch.setattr(runner_mod, ...) patches from being silently defeated; web_caps is computed in run() and passed as a parameter to build_agent_kwargs
The refactoring must not modify runner.py imports, function signatures crossing module boundaries, or logic; no existing tests may be edited; the relocation requires zero monkeypatch repoints
